text: mac2unix documents whether repair was needed, but returns offset after counting all bytes read. The worker sends that result in the fixed field. Thus a nonempty already-valid input also returns a nonzero value; fixed does not mean changed. Scoped manual naming/documentation recommendation: use a byte-count name and number return type, or explicitly return changed when a boolean is intended. The current wrapper does not expose the object to its caller. This is static source and test-code inspection at the frozen accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remain pending; a landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: The worker fixed field is a byte count rather than the documented boolean
